messages:
infra-bot: PAGER — HIGH memory usage detected on hosted-runtime KV cache (us-east-1). Pool: gpt-8b-prod-01. Starting triage and page to on-call.
alice: seeing RSS spikes on shard s-12, mem growth looks like KV entries never evicted. OOM risk.
bob_oncall: taking lead. tagging carol_sre for handoff.
carol_sre: I'm on. What's the traffic & batch settings?
dave_prod: qps ~450 across pool. continuous-batching.window=4096 tokens. We just saw requests that aggregated to ~30k tokens from a single customer thread (likely a runaway convo).
bob_oncall: immediate impact: elevated 5xx for a subset of customers on that pool. CS flagged 3 customers with timeouts/truncation.
customer-support: customer-app-42 reported long latencies (~10s) and truncated outputs; they saw 500s intermittently.
carol_sre: mitigation proposal (quick): 1) enforce per-request max_kv_window=8192 2) lower continuous-batching target batch_size to 8 3) enable conservative eviction (ttl=30m) for this pool. Can we push a config hotfix?
alice: pushing to canary now: set max_kv_window=8192, batch_target=8 on gpt-8b-prod-01-canary.
deploy-bot: deploy started to canary group gpt-8b-prod-01-canary by alice at 2026-03-15T14:07Z
alice: canary observing 4m stability, memory usage down ~30% on canary nodes.
bob_oncall: plan: roll the config with rolling restart, 10% increments. Also consider short-term reject for very large contexts.
carol_sre: agree. Add a router-level guard to reject requests with context > 20k tokens with 413 + X-RI-Reason:kvcache-window. That buys us protection while we roll.
luca: patch for router rule ready, will apply now.
deploy-bot: router rule applied at 2026-03-15T14:15Z by luca
carol_sre: starting full rollout.
deploy-bot: rolling config update in progress: 10% -> 20% -> 40% -> 60% -> 100%
alice: roll complete. Memory profiles flattening across nodes, 5xx rate trending to baseline.
dave_prod: confirmed customer-app-42 traffic reduced, they had an automated job concatenating history. Reached out to advise chunking.
customer-support: notifying affected customers about temporary limits and guidance to chunk long histories; logging any enterprise exception requests.
bob_oncall: incident severity set S3. No data loss observed. Suspected root cause: continuous-batching was concatenating KV prefixes across sessions when session-id absent, causing runaway KV growth for long conversational histories.
carol_sre: immediate next steps: 1) change continuous-batching to require session isolation 2) add unit/integration tests for KV concatenation edge cases 3) instrument eviction metrics and set alerts on cache growth rate
alice: created ticket RI-1234 for code fix and rollout plan.
bob_oncall: handoff: carol_sre will own the incident for next 8h. I'll prepare the incident summary and postmortem draft.
carol_sre: acknowledged. I'll assemble timeline + customer impact and own followups.
observability-bot: alert resolved at 2026-03-15T14:28Z; automated summary posted to #incidents.
bob_oncall: quick commands we used during triage:
```
# top shards by rss
runtimes-cli shards top --sort=rss --limit=5

# set runtime config for pool
runtimes-cli config set --pool gpt-8b-prod-01 --max_kv_window=8192 --batch_target=8

# add router rule to block enormous contexts
router-cli add-rule --name block-large-context --match 'context_tokens>20000' --action reject --status 413
```
carol_sre: postmortem owner: carol_sre. ETA for report: EOD tomorrow. Follow-up items added to sprint board.
alice: :thumbsup:
customer-support: customers updated; one enterprise requested an exception path, routed to sales and security review.
bob_oncall: closing pager for now. Reopen if we see another spike. Thanks all.
infra-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED — mitigation applied. Duration ~21m (first alert -> resolved).
